topics.title: The poet's request for a quill

concepts.learning_objective: Recall how the poet asks the reed for a quill and what the quill stands for.
Interpret the reed's irritated questions and its comparison of the poet to an accountant.

topics.title: Serving the Shahni: the mother tongue Dogri

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the poet presents her mother tongue Dogri as a kind and wealthy Shahni with many servants.
Interpret the reed's act of cutting off its hand as a sign of shared devotion to the language.
Identify personification and other devices used to give the reed and the language human qualities.
Analyse the sense of urgency and emotional attachment the poet shows towards her mother tongue.

topics.title: About the poet and the Dogri script
topics.ncert_sections: About the Poet; Try This Out

concepts.learning_objective: Recall key facts about Padma Sachdev and her writing in Dogri and Hindi.
Explain how Dogri lost its native script Sharade and which scripts are now used to write it.
